Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

The SuperKidney is hardly new — cyber-corps have been working on counters for bioweapons since the Gang of Four days. Dynalar’s newest model, the RV-21, builds upon existing nanoid technology to ensure repeated success without intensive bodymods.

Internal Body Cyberware. Requires Toxin Binders. Whenever the user rolls a Critical Failure (1) on a Resist Torture/Drugs Check made to resist poison or an effect of a drug, they do not roll an implosion 1d10. These rolls are still treated as a 1, however.

NOTE: This is vaguely based on a specific shard in Cyberpunk 2077 which mentions it.

Type: Internal Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Internal Body Cyberware).
